issuing_body: Minnesota District Court, Hennepin County (complaint published by Minnesota Attorney General)
title: State of Minnesota v. Nasib Bakery Food Distribution LLC and Abshir Hossen, civil False Claims Act complaint

acquisition.channel: Official Minnesota Attorney General document host

supports: Paragraph 3 (PDF page 2) alleges the Riverside Park SFSP site, sponsored by Partners in Nutrition and vended by Nasib Bakery, claimed more than $2.8 million reimbursement over October 2020–April 2021 for more than 430,000 breakfasts and 430,000 lunches.
Paragraphs 25–34 (PDF pp. 6–7) describe alleged conflicts of interest where the same person supervised the distribution site and owned its meal vendor, undermining independent cross-checks.
Paragraph 7 (PDF p. 2) states Abshir Hossen sold the bakery in December 2025; the complaint concerns the earlier alleged conduct, and does not identify later owners as participants.
Complaint footnote (PDF p. 6) names a *separate* Partners in Nutrition case, 27-CV-26-16476, and its proposed consent judgment.
does_not_support: That >$2.8 million was all paid to Nasib Bakery personally, as opposed to total site reimbursement claims.
Civil judgment, final liability determination or a verified recovered amount.
That the later owners of the bakery were involved in the alleged 2020–2021 conduct.
A Nasib case number: the publicly released complaint leaves the case number blank.
notes: All claims are asserted in a plaintiff's civil complaint; status must remain CIVIL_ALLEGED. Do not transfer the separately referenced PIN case number to this lawsuit.
